fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on the likelihood of legalized gambling and off-track betting in Dade County; criticism of the Crime Commission’s tactics and local political representation; concerns over emergency medical access and proposals for a medical clearing house; discussion of attempts to shift control of Miami water rates to a board/railroad commission; coverage of harbor/dock expansion and Intracoastal Waterway dredging proposals; commentary on police handling of minor offenses and alleged police cruelty; reporting on the Crime Commission’s probing of county courts; excerpts and allegations from the Esther Regina Jacobson v. Joseph E. Jacobson divorce matter involving claims of judicial/attorney influence; and notes on homestead exemption opinions by Florida Attorney General Richard Ervin, plus additional local columns and advertisements.
